doctrine_note: Per #7 M10 lesson — physics pre-check executed BEFORE elaborate prior-art searches. Preserves all physics pre-check results including killed premises. Push-the-envelope doctrine: every failure creates a search for a better mechanism.

mechanisms.name: Disease-progression adaptive (NPH vs IIH vs post-hemorrhagic)
Patient-specific venous anatomy accommodation (custom curved distal tip)

M1_patient_specific_sizing_imaging.core_mechanism: Pre-procedural CT/MR venography → custom-length/diameter/curvature eShunt manufactured or selected for individual patient venous sinus and jugular anatomy.
M1_patient_specific_sizing_imaging.problem_addressed: Anatomical variation in venous sinus diameter, tortuosity, jugular bulb geometry; standard one-size eShunt may not fit all patients.
M1_patient_specific_sizing_imaging.plausible_physical_principle: CT venography resolution ~0.5mm; eShunt length 5-15cm and diameter 2-4mm are measurable to ~1mm accuracy. 3D reconstruction → custom implant specification.
M1_patient_specific_sizing_imaging.magnitude_estimate: Sinus diameter range 3-8mm across population; eShunt diameter must be 60-80% of sinus diameter for stability. Customization within 0.5mm increments.
M1_patient_specific_sizing_imaging.novelty_concern_pre_check: HIGHLY SATURATED — patient-specific sizing of vascular implants (stents, grafts, TAVR valves) is standard-of-care across interventional cardiology/radiology. eShunt-specific novelty weak on sizing alone.
M1_patient_specific_sizing_imaging.credible_alternative_attack: Every vascular implant is patient-specific-sized; what makes eShunt sizing non-obvious?
M1_patient_specific_sizing_imaging.advance_verdict: WEAK_NOVEL — survives physics but fails novelty pre-check. Mechanism is a routine engineering adaptation, not a patentable invention.

M2_posture_adaptive_gravity_compensating.core_mechanism: Gravity-compensating valve integrated into eShunt that responds to patient posture (supine vs upright) by adjusting drainage resistance to compensate for hydrostatic column changes.
M2_posture_adaptive_gravity_compensating.problem_addressed: Over-drainage in upright posture (siphon effect) and under-drainage in supine; classic VP shunt complication.
M2_posture_adaptive_gravity_compensating.plausible_physical_principle: Hydrostatic column from chest to head = ~30cm; ΔP = ρgh ≈ 22 mmHg. Patient upright → ICP drops 10-15 mmHg with compensatory venous collapse. Posture-induced ICP swings well-documented (10-15 mmHg typical).
M2_posture_adaptive_gravity_compensating.magnitude_estimate: Hydrostatic column difference supine-to-upright ≈ 30 cmH2O ≈ 22 mmHg. Clinically consequential.
M2_posture_adaptive_gravity_compensating.novelty_concern_pre_check: HIGHLY SATURATED — Medtronic Strata NSC, Sophysa Polaris SPV, Miethke ProSA all have integrated gravity/anti-siphon units. This is standard-of-care for VP shunts.
M2_posture_adaptive_gravity_compensating.eShunt_specific_caveat: eShunt drains to venous sinus (not peritoneum), so hydrostatic column is shorter (head-to-jugular, not head-to-peritoneum). The siphon effect is therefore LESS pronounced for eShunt than VP. This WEAKENS the clinical need for a gravity unit and REDUCES the novelty of any posture-adaptive mechanism specific to eShunt.
M2_posture_adaptive_gravity_compensating.advance_verdict: SATURATED + WEAKENED_BY_eShunt_ANATOMY — basic posture compensation is well-known; eShunt-specific clinical need is reduced. Likely NOT buyer-relevant as a distinct invention.

M3_patient_specific_opening_pressure_pro.core_mechanism: Programmable valve with patient-specific opening pressure set non-invasively via external magnet, matched to individual patient's ICP target.
M3_patient_specific_opening_pressure_pro.problem_addressed: Different patients need different ICP targets (NPH: 5-15 mmHg; IIH: 15-25 cmH2O; post-hem: 10-20 mmHg).
M3_patient_specific_opening_pressure_pro.plausible_physical_principle: Spring-loaded ball-in-cone or slit-valve mechanism, opening pressure tunable 5-200 mmH2O via external magnetic adjustment.
M3_patient_specific_opening_pressure_pro.magnitude_estimate: Adjustment range 0.5-2.0 (performance level) × 10-20 mmH2O per setting — standard shunt valve specification.
M3_patient_specific_opening_pressure_pro.novelty_concern_pre_check: EXTREMELY SATURATED — Medtronic Strata (1990s), Sophysa Polaris, Miethke ProGAV 2.0, Codman Hakim — ALL programmable valves with this exact mechanism. Multiple patents; clinical standard-of-care since 1990s.
M3_patient_specific_opening_pressure_pro.advance_verdict: DESTROYED_BY_PRIOR_ART — basic patient-specific opening pressure is saturated; no novelty.

M4_patient_specific_csf_production_rate_.core_mechanism: Flow-metered eShunt that explicitly measures drainage rate and adjusts resistance to match patient's individual CSF production rate (rather than using opening pressure alone).
M4_patient_specific_csf_production_rate_.problem_addressed: CSF production rate varies 0.25-0.5 mL/min across patients; pressure-only valves cannot directly target net drainage rate = production rate.
M4_patient_specific_csf_production_rate_.plausible_physical_principle: Flow sensor (thermal, ultrasonic, or pressure-drop based) measures drainage rate in real-time; closed-loop controller adjusts resistance to maintain net drainage = estimated production rate.
M4_patient_specific_csf_production_rate_.magnitude_estimate: CSF production 0.35 mL/min (typical); patient variation ±30%. Targeting accuracy ±0.05 mL/min would be clinically meaningful (prevents both over- and under-drainage).
M4_patient_specific_csf_production_rate_.physics_verdict: PASSES_PHYSICS — flow measurement in low-flow regime (0.1-1.0 mL/min) is feasible (thermal mass flow sensors achieve ±5% accuracy at these rates).
M4_patient_specific_csf_production_rate_.physiology_verdict: PARTIAL_PHYSIOLOGY_CONCERN — measuring individual CSF production rate requires invasive ventricular perfusion or semi-invasive MR aqueduct flow imaging. Routine clinical measurement is impractical.
M4_patient_specific_csf_production_rate_.novelty_concern_pre_check: MEDIUM — flow-regulated shunts proposed in literature (Oral 2017, Pieri 2017 — VEP shunt). Slightly differentiated but the mechanism (flow measurement + closed-loop) is taught.
M4_patient_specific_csf_production_rate_.advance_verdict: MARGINAL_NOVEL — survives physics but production rate measurement impractical for routine clinical use, and flow-regulated shunt concept is partially saturated. Buyer may not find this distinct enough from existing programmable valves.

M5_sleep_state_circadian_adaptive_draina.core_mechanism: eShunt with integrated accelerometer/posture sensor that detects sleep state (supine + circadian time) and reduces drainage rate during sleep to prevent nocturnal over-drainage, with patient-specific calibration of day/night drainage target.
M5_sleep_state_circadian_adaptive_draina.problem_addressed: Supine sleep posture eliminates hydrostatic column → ICP rises 5-10 mmHg at night. Over-drainage at night causes morning low-pressure headaches. Sleep apnea patients have additional ICP spikes (20-30 mmHg).
M5_sleep_state_circadian_adaptive_draina.plausible_physical_principle: Accelerometer detects supine posture + circadian clock detects night-time → valve resistance increases by ΔR proportional to patient-specific nocturnal ICP rise. Established chronobiology + control theory.
M5_sleep_state_circadian_adaptive_draina.magnitude_estimate: Posture-induced ICP change 5-10 mmHg; sleep apnea spikes 20-30 mmHg. Clinically meaningful effect size.
M5_sleep_state_circadian_adaptive_draina.physiology_verdict: PASSES_PHYSIOLOGY — nocturnal ICP variation and over-drainage symptoms are well-documented in VP shunt literature.
M5_sleep_state_circadian_adaptive_draina.novelty_concern_pre_check: MEDIUM-HIGH — VIEshunt (2025, Fluids and Barriers of the CNS) teaches posture-specific ICP references (12 mmHg supine, -3 mmHg upright) with IMU + micro pump + pressure sensor. M5 is partially saturated by VIEshunt.
M5_sleep_state_circadian_adaptive_draina.eShunt_specific_novel_angle: eShunt drains to venous sinus (not peritoneum), so patient's venous pressure profile at the drainage site is the relevant outflow pressure. Venous sinus pressure varies diurnally (sleep apnea → venous congestion → P_venous rises 5-15 mmHg). Patient-specific calibration of nocturnal venous pressure profile + adaptive drainage is eShunt-specific.
M5_sleep_state_circadian_adaptive_draina.advance_verdict: CONDITIONALLY_NOVEL — basic posture compensation saturated by VIEshunt, but patient-specific circadian + sleep-apnea-venous-congestion adaptation may distinguish. Requires passage-level VIEshunt audit.

M6_disease_progression_adaptive_NPH_vs_I.core_mechanism: eShunt that LEARNS patient's disease trajectory from chronic pressure/flow patterns and adapts drainage profile over months. Initial setting based on diagnosis (NPH/IIH/post-hem); longitudinal adaptation as disease progresses or resolves.
M6_disease_progression_adaptive_NPH_vs_I.problem_addressed: Different diseases have different optimal drainage profiles AND different trajectories: NPH is chronic stable; IIH may resolve with weight loss; post-hemorrhagic often improves as blood clears.
M6_disease_progression_adaptive_NPH_vs_I.plausible_physical_principle: ML on chronic pressure waveform + drainage pattern detects disease state and trajectory. Adaptive controller modifies drainage target over time.
M6_disease_progression_adaptive_NPH_vs_I.magnitude_estimate: Disease-specific drainage profile differences are qualitative (NPH: low-normal ICP; IIH: high ICP; post-hem: high protein + elevated ICP). Trajectory signal: pressure trend over weeks/months.
M6_disease_progression_adaptive_NPH_vs_I.physiology_verdict: PARTIAL_PHYSIOLOGY_CONCERN — disease trajectory detection from a single pressure sensor at venous drainage site is INFORMATION-LIMITED. Different diseases can produce similar pressure patterns; ML may not be able to distinguish reliably without external data (imaging, clinical symptoms).
M6_disease_progression_adaptive_NPH_vs_I.novelty_concern_pre_check: MEDIUM — disease-specific shunt programming exists (different valve settings for NPH vs IIH); ML-driven longitudinal adaptation is novel but depends on identifiability.
M6_disease_progression_adaptive_NPH_vs_I.advance_verdict: CONDITIONALLY_NOVEL — survives physics but identifiability concern (similar to #1 V22 unidentifiability). Disease trajectory inference from a single pressure sensor may be mathematically non-identifiable. CRITICAL RISK.

M7_patient_specific_venous_anatomy_custo.core_mechanism: Custom curved/distal-tip eShunt geometry matched to individual patient's venous sinus anatomy (hypoplastic transverse sinus 25% prevalence, arachnoid granulations, sinus stenosis in IIH).
M7_patient_specific_venous_anatomy_custo.problem_addressed: Anatomical variation in venous sinus geometry; standard straight-tip eShunt may not seat optimally in variant anatomy.
M7_patient_specific_venous_anatomy_custo.plausible_physical_principle: CT venography → 3D sinus geometry → custom curved distal tip to match patient's sinus trajectory. Standard patient-specific implant methodology (TAVR, custom stent grafts).
M7_patient_specific_venous_anatomy_custo.magnitude_estimate: Sinus curvature radius 5-30mm; custom tip curvature within 2-3 standard presets covers 90% of patients; full customization needed for severe variants (~5%).
M7_patient_specific_venous_anatomy_custo.novelty_concern_pre_check: HIGHLY SATURATED — custom curved-tip catheters and patient-specific stent geometry are well-known across interventional radiology/cardiology. eShunt-specific application is a routine engineering adaptation.
M7_patient_specific_venous_anatomy_custo.advance_verdict: WEAK_NOVEL — survives physics but fails novelty pre-check. Routine engineering adaptation, not patentable invention.

M8_closed_loop_non_invasive_icp_proxy_fe.core_mechanism: eShunt receives periodic non-invasive ICP proxy measurements (optic nerve sheath diameter via ultrasound, tympanic membrane displacement, or transcranial Doppler pulsatility index) from external measurement device; adjusts drainage target based on proxy trend.
M8_closed_loop_non_invasive_icp_proxy_fe.problem_addressed: Current shunts require invasive ICP measurement (lumbar puncture, EVD) for adjustment; non-invasive closed-loop enables home monitoring + autonomous adaptation.
M8_closed_loop_non_invasive_icp_proxy_fe.plausible_physical_principle: ONSD-ultrasound correlates with ICP (r~0.7, Robba 2018); ONSD >5.8mm predicts ICP >20cmH2O with ~90% sensitivity. TCD pulsatility index correlates with ICP. eShunt receives measurement via wireless (BLE/NFC) and adjusts drainage target.
M8_closed_loop_non_invasive_icp_proxy_fe.magnitude_estimate: ONSD measurement error ~0.3mm; threshold sensitivity 90%; specificity ~85%. Sufficient for trend monitoring (not absolute ICP measurement). Clinically actionable.
M8_closed_loop_non_invasive_icp_proxy_fe.physics_verdict: PASSES_PHYSICS — ONSD ultrasound well-established; wireless implantable communication standard (CardioMEMS precedent).
M8_closed_loop_non_invasive_icp_proxy_fe.physiology_verdict: PASSES_PHYSIOLOGY — non-invasive ICP proxies clinically validated.
M8_closed_loop_non_invasive_icp_proxy_fe.novelty_concern_pre_check: MEDIUM — closed-loop implantable systems exist (CardioMEMS for HF, Senseonics for glucose). ONSD-based ICP monitoring exists (clinical literature, multiple devices). Combination (ONSD → eShunt adjustment) is novel as a system.
M8_closed_loop_non_invasive_icp_proxy_fe.eShunt_specific_novel_angle: First closed-loop CSF shunt using non-invasive ICP proxy. Prior programmable shunts require manual adjustment by clinician after invasive measurement. This is a SYSTEM-level invention (closed-loop non-invasive adaptation) rather than a component-level invention.
M8_closed_loop_non_invasive_icp_proxy_fe.advance_verdict: CONDITIONALLY_NOVEL — survives physics; novel system-level combination. Requires prior-art search to confirm no prior closed-loop non-invasive ICP-adaptive shunt exists.

physics_precheck_summary.honest_negative_finding_M1: Patient-specific sizing of vascular implants is standard-of-care (TAVR, stent grafts). No eShunt-specific novelty on sizing alone. WEAK_NOVEL.
physics_precheck_summary.honest_negative_finding_M2: Posture-adaptive gravity valves are standard-of-care for VP shunts (Strata NSC, Polaris SPV, ProSA). eShunt-specific clinical need is REDUCED because eShunt drains to venous sinus (shorter hydrostatic column than head-to-peritoneum). SATURATED + WEAKENED_BY_eShunt_ANATOMY.
physics_precheck_summary.honest_negative_finding_M3: Programmable patient-specific opening pressure is the textbook definition of standard-of-care shunt valves (Strata, Polaris, Hakim, ProGAV). DESTROYED_BY_PRIOR_ART.
physics_precheck_summary.honest_negative_finding_M7: Custom curved-tip catheters are routine engineering adaptation across interventional radiology. WEAK_NOVEL.
physics_precheck_summary.leading_candidate_after_physics_precheck: M8 — Closed-loop non-invasive ICP proxy feedback. PASSES physics, PASSES physiology, NOVEL system-level combination (ONSD → eShunt adjustment). Strongest candidate.
physics_precheck_summary.second_candidate: M5 — Sleep-state/circadian adaptive drainage with eShunt-specific venous-pressure-aware calibration. PASSES physics, PASSES physiology, partial saturation by VIEshunt but eShunt-specific venous physiology may distinguish.
physics_precheck_summary.third_candidate: M4 — Patient-specific CSF production-rate-matched flow target. PASSES physics, PARTIAL physiology concern (production rate measurement impractical for routine clinical use). MARGINAL novelty.
physics_precheck_summary.fourth_candidate_with_risk: M6 — Disease-progression adaptive ML. PASSES physics, PARTIAL physiology/identifiability concern (single-sensor disease trajectory detection may be mathematically non-identifiable, similar to #1 V22 unidentifiability). CRITICAL RISK.
physics_precheck_summary.pivots_after_precheck: Per push-the-envelope doctrine ('every failure creates a search for a better mechanism'), pivoting leading candidate from generic patient-specific sizing (M1, M3, M7 — saturated) to M8 (system-level closed-loop non-invasive feedback) which represents a true architecture-level invention rather than a component-level adaptation.

advance_to_prior_art_search.rationale: Per #7 M10 lesson — physics pre-check BEFORE elaborate prior-art searches saves time. M1, M2, M3, M7 fail novelty pre-check; M4, M5, M6, M8 advance to multi-source prior-art search.
